gate_objections: part 1 (pages 1-31): EMPPRE-Q5: the source routes 'No' to EMPPRE-N7, but the inventory has no jump from EMPPRE-Q5 to EMPPRE-N7. It folds N7's test (EMPPRE-Q1 = permanently unable to work) into two conditional jumps from Q5 straight to EMPPRE-N12 or EMPPRE-Q8. The host resolves jumps, so the Q5 -> N7 jump should be recorded as printed.

part 1 (pages 1-31): EMPPRE-Q7: the inventory has jumps from EMPPRE-Q7 to EMPPRE-N12 and EMPPRE-Q8, which resolve the N7 logic. The source prints no jump on Q7; the flow simply continues to N7, whose branches are 'Yes Go to EMPPRE-N12' and 'Otherwise Go to EMPPRE-Q8'. Record Q7 -> N7 and N7's own two branches.

part 1 (pages 1-31): EMPPRE-N4 (after Q4) and EMPPRE-N7 are internal-logic checkpoints that are not recorded as nodes. Their tests are copied into conditions on the jumps from Q4 and Q5/Q7. By contrast, EMPPRE-N6, N11A, N12, J1.N2 and EXPRE-N1 are kept as entries. This is inconsistent: either record all checkpoints and jump to them, or none.

part 1 (pages 1-31): EMPPRE-N12: the source target is 'EXPRE-Q1', but the inventory changes it to EXPRE-N1. This rewrites the printed target. Record the target as printed, or flag the discrepancy explicitly.

part 1 (pages 1-31): Several jumps have no printed source: EMPPRE-Q9 -> EMPPRE-N11A, EMPPRE-J1.Q7B -> EMPPRE-J1.Q8, and EXPRE-Q4D -> EXPRE-Q5A, whose condition '@[EXPRE-Q4A] >= 0' is meaningless. EMPPRE-J1.Q2A -> EMPPRE-J1.Q3 is recorded with a condition on EMPPRE-J1.N2, a node whose only 'Go to' is to J1.Q2A. These are inferred sequential flow, not printed routing; remove them or tie them to the printed instruction.

part 2 (pages 32-60): The interviewer-notice screens EXPRE-Q6D, DEMPRE-Q1A (intro), DEMPRE-Q2A, Q4A, Q9A, Q9B, Q10A, Q10B, DEMPRE-Q14A, and EDUPRE-Q1A, Q9A, Q11A, Q13A are marked scope 'in' but are not listed as questions or messages. Several jumps target them (e.g. EXPRE-Q6C to EXPRE-Q6D, DEMPRE-Q2 to DEMPRE-Q2A, DEMPRE-Q9 to Q9A/Q9B, EDUPRE-Q1 to EDUPRE-Q1A), so those targets resolve to nothing in the part. Either list each as a question with its verbatim text and printed id, or drop the jumps to them and record the checks instead.

part 2 (pages 32-60): These same notice screens have no outgoing jump or continuation. Each prints 'press <Enter> to continue' or 'go back to previous question', so the route that leaves them is not recorded. Examples are DEMPRE-Q2A to DEMPRE-Q3 and EDUPRE-Q9A to EDUPRE-Q10.
